# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_RIBBON_CONFLUENCE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When an overnight gap occurs and the EMA ribbon (8,21,34) opposes the gap direction, price tends to fill the gap as a mean‑reverting move. This captures the fade after an overextended open, exploiting the ribbon’s contrary bias as a signal of exhaustion.

## Mechanism

Entry: If gap up (open > prior day high) AND 8‑EMA < 21‑EMA < 34‑EMA (bearish ribbon) AND price trades below prior day close within the first 60 min, enter short at the close of the bar that breaks below prior day close. For gap down (open < prior day low) AND 8‑EMA > 21‑EMA > 34‑EMA (bullish ribbon) AND price trades above prior day close withinrieron first 60 min, enter long at the close of the bar that breaks above prior day close. Exit: chart‑stop at gap extreme (prior day high for shorts, prior day low for longs), TP1 at gap fill (prior day close), runner trail 15 % off high‑water‑mark. Regime filter: VIX between 12‑22 and gap size >0.3×ATR(14); avoid gaps >1 % (news‑driven).
